question: Can a black hole die or disappear?
short_answer: Yes, black holes evaporate over time through Hawking radiation. A black hole with the mass of the Sun takes about 10^67 years to evaporate, while tiny primordial black holes evaporate rapidly in explosive bursts.
full_explanation: As a black hole emits Hawking radiation, it loses mass and heats up. In its final seconds, a small black hole radiates its remaining energy away in a high-energy gamma-ray explosion.
